content:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — GCP marketplace invoice INV-4920 shows in our billing dashboard but the CSV attachment is empty when we download it. Can someone from billing ops poke?
billing-bot: automated upload failed for INV-4920: checksum mismatch (error code 412). Link: https://gcp.marketplace/example/invoices/INV-4920
Samira (FinOps): ugh. Do we have the original partner upload?
Aisha Khan: Partner portal shows file as "uploaded" but download returns 0 bytes. Quick curl I ran: 
```
GET /invoices/INV-4920/download HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 0
```
Jon Pritchard: can you paste the first few rows of what should be in the csv? want to confirm it's not a parsing issue.
Aisha Khan: expected header/row: `account_id,usage_tokens,amount`
sample row: `acct-123,120000,120.00`
Lee Chen: cc @partners-team — if partner re-sent a corrupted file we need their S3 object id. Did we get an upload event from their side?
billing-bot: upload webhook received: partner_object=gs://partner-uploads/INV-4920-2026-03-01.csv size=0 bytes
Samira (FinOps): ok, looks like empty blob. We need partner to re-upload. Meanwhile if invoices already billed to resellers we may need a provisional credit. How much was billed?
Aisha Khan: platform charged reseller $1,420.37 on 2026-03-02. Line-levels missing, so can't reconcile usage-based fees.
Jon Pritchard: if they re-upload by EOD we can avoid a credit. If not, we need an emergency reconciliation path. Samira — do you have authority to approve a provisional credit?
Samira (FinOps): I can approve provisional credits up to $2k for data sync issues. Approved to issue up to $1,500 provisional credit pending partner reupload. Document reason in ticket. :white_check_mark:
Lee Chen: Thanks — I'll ping partner ops to request immediate reupload and S3 object ID. Partner contact: julie@partnerco.com.
Aisha Khan: filed ticket #4892 with partner ops and attached logs. JulIe replied: "we re-sent file, TTL 5m — link: gs://partner-uploads/INV-4920-2026-03-01-v2.csv"
billing-bot: new upload detected: partner_object=gs://partner-uploads/INV-4920-2026-03-01-v2.csv size=18,432 bytes, checksum OK
Aisha Khan: downloaded v2, CSV looks good — rows present, totals reconcile to $1,420.37.
Samira (FinOps): cancel provisional credit. We'll run reconciliation and close invoice. Creating credit memo: none required. Noted in #4892.
Jon Pritchard: updating billing ledger and closing ticket. wrote: `UPDATE invoices SET status='reconciled' WHERE invoice_id='INV-4920';`
Lee Chen: great work, thanks team.
Aisha Khan: thanks everyone :pray:
